# Navigating Seasons Counselling Services

> BACP-accredited online and telephone integrative counselling across the UK, led by Frances Palmer-Thompson (FdA, MBACP Accred, Accredited Sight Loss Counsellor). Specialising in four areas: complex trauma/C-PTSD, sight loss, chronic health conditions, and neurodiversity-affirming therapy. Also works with life transitions and other common reasons for seeking counselling, and offers clinical supervision to qualified, newly qualified and trainee counsellors (Fran is a Supervisor in Training, currently undertaking the CPCAB Level 6 Certificate in Therapeutic Counselling Supervision). Sessions are for adults and young people aged 16+, delivered online or by telephone, not in person.

## Pages

- [Home](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/): Overview of the counselling practice, the areas Fran specialises in, credentials, and the separate clinical supervision offering.
- [About Me](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/about.html): Frances Palmer-Thompson's background, lived experience of sight loss, and credentials (BACP Accredited Counsellor, Accredited Sight Loss Counsellor, FdA Integrative Counselling, Level 4 Certificate in Rehabilitation Studies: Visual Impairment).
- [How I Can Help](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/how-i-can-help.html): Four areas Fran specialises in (complex trauma/C-PTSD, sight loss, chronic health conditions, neurodiversity-affirming therapy), plus other reasons people seek counselling such as life transitions, anxiety, depression, grief, stress and workplace burnout.
- [How I Work](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/how-i-work.html): An integrative approach blending Person-Centred, Psychodynamic, CBT, Transactional Analysis, Gestalt, and IFS-informed parts work.
- [Services & Fees](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/services-and-fees.html): Counselling fees (free 25-minute initial conversation, £40 initial assessment, £50 per 50-minute session), clinical supervision fees (£40 per 60 minutes, £30 for counselling students), availability and cancellation policy.
- [Clinical Supervision](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/clinical-supervision.html): One-to-one Integrative clinical supervision for qualified, newly qualified and trainee counsellors, online and by telephone UK-wide. Fran is a Supervisor in Training currently undertaking the CPCAB Level 6 Certificate in Therapeutic Counselling Supervision; supervision for counselling students depends on their training provider accepting supervision from a supervisor in training. Draws on the Integrative Developmental Model (IDM) and the Seven-Eyed Model, within the BACP Ethical Framework. Fees, approach and supervision FAQs.
- [Qualifications](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/qualifications.html): BACP accreditation, completed qualifications, further training, and training currently in progress.
- [Articles](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/articles.html): Navigating Counselling, a seasonal series of articles by Frances Palmer-Thompson on counselling, mental health and finding the right support, with a new article each season.
- [Navigating Counselling: Finding Your Way Through the Noise](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/navigating-counselling-autumn-2026.html): Autumn 2026 article on finding your way through the information about counselling, asking questions, and making an informed choice.
- [Crisis Support](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/crisis-support.html): UK crisis helplines for anyone needing immediate support. Navigating Seasons is not itself an emergency or crisis service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/privacy-policy.html): How personal information is collected, used, and protected, in line with UK GDPR, for counselling clients and clinical supervisees.
- [Contact](https://navigatingseasons.co.uk/contact.html): Contact form, phone, SMS, email, LinkedIn, Facebook, and frequently asked questions.

## Notes

- Not an emergency or crisis service. Anyone in immediate danger or crisis should be directed to the Crisis Support page, or to call 999 or Samaritans (116 123, free, 24/7).
- Based in Oldbury, West Midlands, serving clients UK-wide online and by telephone only (no in-person sessions).
- Christmas and New Year 2026/27: closed from Thursday 24 December 2026 to Saturday 2 January 2027, with sessions and replies to enquiries restarting on Monday 4 January 2027. Samaritans (116 123), Shout (text SHOUT to 85258) and NHS 111 remain available 24/7 throughout, including Christmas Day.
